image_description: A vintage-style orange and cream minibus (resembling a Volkswagen Type 2 or similar panel van conversion) driving on a paved road. The vehicle features a boxy shape, a row of side windows, a front grille with headlights, and a destination sign above the windshield. The background consists of brick residential houses and a metal fence.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle clearly exhibits a compact, boxy silhouette distinct from full-size buses, consistent with minibus proportions.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large split windshield is visible at the front, and multiple rectangular side windows are clearly defined along the passenger cabin.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle height is appropriate for a minibus. A door seam is visible behind the front wheel arch, indicating a front/mid-body entrance.
The vertical seam and handle placement near the front wheel well are consistent with a sliding or folding door mechanism typical of this vehicle class.
The short hood and flat front face indicate the presence of an engine compartment (or rear-engine layout access panel) typical of vans/minibuses.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is taken from a front-three-quarter angle; the rear of the vehicle is completely occluded and outside the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has a two-tone orange and cream livery. A destination blind/sign is visible above the windshield, serving as route marking.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front wheel is proportional to the vehicle body, featuring a standard rim design consistent with van-sized tires.
The window configuration and overall size suggest a capacity within the 4-10 passenger range, fitting the minibus definition.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the license plate ('...0123') and the destination sign is slightly soft and lacks the crisp edge definition of real photography, showing minor AI-generated character ambiguity, though it is largely legible.
The bricks in the background houses show slight repetitive patterning and 'smudging' rather than distinct mortar lines, typical of generative background noise.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific vehicle taxonomy and distinguish it from similar classes like 'pickup truck' or 'full-size bus'.
To verify the spatial relationship between the vehicle and the background fence/houses, ensuring no geometric melting or grounding errors.
To check for boundary bleeding between the glass/windows and the body paint, and ensure wheels are topologically complete circles.
To rigorously audit the legibility and structural correctness of the generated text elements which showed minor gibberish.

focus_areas: Wheel geometry and grounding contact points
Window frame consistency and reflection logic
Text legibility on license plate and signage
Boundary sharpness between vehicle body and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the wheel rims; AI often generates oval or melted rims. Verify if the destination sign text is structurally coherent or just glyph-like shapes. Check if the shadow under the bus matches the lighting direction of the background houses.
